music: A low string entry, sustained and unresolved.

title: 工牌回兜里
summary: Close on her hand and the table: she moves her hand off the edge onto the badge, picks it up, puts it into her own pocket and presses the pocket flat, all while telling him her pay runs to the end of the month and she has an attendance record every day.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1)'s hand moving from the table edge onto the badge; 钱经理 (S3) out of frame at the far side of the table.
[Shot 1] Close on 苏小满 (S1)'s hand and the table top: her hand comes off the edge onto the badge lying face-up, picks it up and goes down into her own apron pocket, then presses the pocket flat; the top two thirds are her hand, the badge and the table's wooden edge, the bottom third the table and floor beyond; she says as she does it, [Chinese] 工资结到月底。我每天有出勤记录。
[Shot 2] At 00:05.600, The same close after the pocket is pressed flat: the badge is gone from the table, a clean ring of unshadowed wood is left where it lay, and her hand comes away and drops to her side at the near edge of frame.
soundscape: The badge's clip brushing the apron, her low voice, the room's quiet.

title: 她转身出门
summary: Medium: 苏小满 (S1) finishes, turns away from 钱经理 (S3) with her back to him and walks towards the door at the near end, not once looking back at the stack of claim forms.
shots:

[Shot 2] At 00:05.200, Closer from behind as she reaches the door: her hand goes to the handle, her shoulders stay square and unhurried, and the office behind her stays bright, with the badge's clean ring still visible on the table.

title: 门在身后关上
summary: Close on the door: she goes out through it and it closes behind her, cutting off the last strip of corridor daylight; the room is left with 钱经理 (S3) alone beside the table.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: the door at the NEAR end of the office, closing behind 苏小满 (S1); 钱经理 (S3) in the room.
[Shot 1] Close on the door at the near end of the office: it swings closed behind 苏小满 (S1) and the handle settles; the last strip of corridor daylight narrows to a line and is gone, leaving the office lit only by its own ceiling lights and the blind; the bottom third is the door's lower panel and the floor in front of it.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, The closed door held for a beat: the handle stills, the room beyond it stays bright and even, and the door's flat panel takes a soft vertical band of light down its middle.
soundscape: The door's latch clicking home, her footsteps receding on the other side, the room's quiet.

title: 他盯着门
summary: Close on 钱经理 (S3): he stares at the closed door for two seconds, his throat works once, and the smile will not stay on his face.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 钱经理 (S3) alone in the office beside the long table, facing the closed door at the near end.
[Shot 1] Close on 钱经理 (S3) alone: he stares at the closed door at the near end of the room for two seconds, his throat works once, and the smile he had will not stay where it was; the ceiling light is even on the whole front of his face so the change is fully readable.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.400, The same close held: his eyes stay on the door, the sweat on his forehead has not dried, and behind him the bright office and the badge's clean ring on the table stay in soft focus.
soundscape: The room's quiet, his uneven breath, a pipe ticking somewhere in the wall.

title: 喂，是我
summary: 钱经理 (S3) snatches the telephone off the long table, turns his back on the door and speaks into it in a low voice, his eyes flicking towards the door as he talks.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 钱经理 (S3) alone in the office at the near side of the long table, reaching for the telephone; the door closed at the near end behind him.
[Shot 1] Medium close on 钱经理 (S3): he snatches the telephone off the long table, turns his back on the closed door and speaks into the receiver in a low voice, his eyes flicking towards the door as he talks, [Chinese] 喂，是我。那个苏小满，今天来闹了一场。地毯那笔账，她知道。
[Shot 2] At 00:07.000, Closer on him as he finishes the line: the receiver is held hard to his ear, his eyes have gone back to the table, and the office stays bright and even around him with the blind's light lying across the wood.
soundscape: The receiver picked up, his lowered voice down the line, the room's quiet.

title: 牌位空了一圈
summary: Close on the table top: the stack of claim forms is still where it was, and where the badge lay there is now only a clean ring of unshadowed wood.
shots:

title: 目光落回那叠单
summary: Medium: 钱经理 (S3) stands with the receiver to his ear and his eyes drop back to the stack of claim forms on the table; the blind lays the mid-morning light across the desk in bands.
